justification: Both surfaces show human figures and quadrupeds arranged along a horizontal line, but that is as generic as depicted content gets; A presents a large, naturalistic camel led in profile by a detailed costumed attendant beneath a rosette frieze, while B shows only tiny stick-like matchstick figures and rows of small schematic signs with no comparable attributes or framing motifs.
